basis: PROPOSED 2026-10-29 by the leave-one-site-out check (docs/proposals/shape-rules-v3-loso.md, out/loso/shape_v2/loso_shape_v2.json): landers/shape_v2.json with tile_top withdrawn. The three rules kept are unchanged, with the gains measured on all eight tuning strips in the first tuning-loop session; each one also holds under leave-one-site-out (lift holds on the held-back site, pass fraction under the bar on every fold and on every strip). tile_top held its lift on held-out sites (injection hardware 35 against 32 of 72) but its pass fraction is a property of the ground, not the object: 0.006 to 0.454 by strip, over the bar on five of eight strips, and over it pooled (0.081) when the busiest strip is held back. Re-measure and re-version whenever the detector changes.

rules.name: saturated
rules.basis: landers/shape_v1.json: at least one pixel at the sensor's saturation; natural ground at HiRISE exposure rarely saturates, bright hardware often does

rules.name: shadow_strong
rules.basis: dark on the anti-sun side only, far beyond what polygon troughs and slopes produce, with a length that reads as a 0.5 to 3 m object; bright branch only, the shadow branch already selects on this

rules.name: dark_shadow
rules.basis: a dark object that still casts a shadow of the right length stands above the ground; a dark patch in the ground does not
